## Highlights

- Adds optional reset-credit expiry details to the Full indicator layout, disabled by default.
- Adds `usage-indicator enable-credit-expiry` and `usage-indicator disable-credit-expiry`.
- Applies credit-expiry preference changes immediately to a running indicator without requiring a restart or another usage request.
- Shows only the earliest valid future expiry returned by the existing Codex app-server rate-limit response; credit counts are not displayed.
- Preserves the existing `Full -> Narrow -> Compact -> Hidden` model by removing optional credit details before falling back to Narrow.
- Keeps existing settings compatible and safely defaults the new preference to disabled.
- Preserves installer startup detection when upgrading from either the legacy three-line or current four-line status format.

[Compare `v0.2.1...v0.2.2`](https://github.com/mursyidd/usage-indicator-for-codex/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2)
